name: ssm-guiconnect
description: AWS Systems Manager GUI Connect Systems Manager GUI Connect, a component of Fleet Manager, lets you connect to your Window Server-type Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instances using the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP).

subcommands.name: delete-connection-recording-preferences
subcommands.description: Deletes the preferences for recording RDP connections.

subcommands.name: get-connection-recording-preferences
subcommands.description: Returns the preferences specified for recording RDP connections in the requesting Amazon Web Services account and Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: update-connection-recording-preferences
subcommands.description: Updates the preferences for recording RDP connections.
